decision: Born from worktree-isolation-v0's D012 split (operator decision tree, 2026-06-11): after 8 sufficiency rounds with 100% clearance each, fresh highs kept landing in the guard/cleanup threat-model area — F003/F005 moved here wholesale (their fully-hardened acceptance text preserved) so v0's substrate can ship while enforcement gets ONE holistic design pass instead of one-hole-per-round paid refinement. DO NOT LOCK before the design pass resolves the carried inputs: (1) operator decision on gitignored files in cleanup semantics (v0 r8 high f-330122e8396e — contract wording vs regenerable-by-declaration); (2) override evidence-write durability (v0 r8 med f-6d97ffb6949f); (3) the full threat-model conjunction pinned up front.
rationale: Operator: worktree isolation is foundational; the gate findings were real, but continuing paid rounds was the wrong vehicle for completing a threat model.

decision: OPERATOR LEAN recorded for the design pass (2026-06-11, decided OUTSIDE v0 per operator instruction): gitignored files are still untracked human/workspace state and should NOT be deleted by default during cleanup; cleanup should REPORT ignored content separately, and deleting it requires a later explicit, audited cleanup command (its own affordance, not a side effect of worktree removal). Resolve the exact mechanics (how git worktree remove's native behavior toward ignored files is constrained or replaced) in the pre-lock design pass.
rationale: Operator: do not decide cleanup semantics inside v0; default-preserve beats default-delete for human/workspace state even when regenerable.

decision: OPERATOR POLICY DECISIONS (2026-06-11, the pre-lock design pass this plan required — verbatim policy): OPERATOR-LOCAL CONFIG: default is DECLARE missing/divergent config explicitly (never silent divergence); optionally COPY selected declared-safe local config on create (allowlist, opt-in); AVOID live symlinks for v1 unless a file is explicitly marked safe and non-secret (practically: no symlinks in v1). CLEANUP: PRESERVE gitignored files by default — they are still local state; removal is explicit, audited, and REFUSES unless the worktree is clean under the policy being applied (gitignored content present therefore blocks removal, reported explicitly; the deferred explicit-audited-cleanup-of-ignored-content command from D002 stays future scope). These resolve the carried design inputs; the threat model is now pinned in full in plan.md and the features.
rationale: Operator: worktree v0 is in real use; the remaining ambiguity is exactly the dangerous edges — refusal semantics, cleanup behavior, gitignored preservation, local config propagation, evidence durability under overrides/failed writes.

decision: Round-1 sufficiency findings (NO threat-model findings — the D003 design pass held; 2 high + 1 med, all test-coverage pins) resolved: (1) the ignored-content refusal fixture is pinned BY NAME in F002 (porcelain-clean worktree with gitignored files refuses removal, each path reported — the central preservation case); (2) F003 declares divergence in BOTH directions by default (missing AND already-present-but-different allowlisted files reported at create with no flag); (3) F001 guard entry-point tests pin auditor stubbing + zero-live-call/no-network assertions for the audit and dispatch paths.
rationale: One offline pass, one re-lock per cadence.

decision: Round-2 findings (100% clearance; 1 high matrix_pin + 2 med) resolved: (1) override matrix pinned per refusal class — JUDGMENT classes (wrong path, unhealthy binding incl. swapped-repo/drift, indeterminate state) are overridable with reason+durable evidence; CORRUPT REGISTRY is NEVER overridable (infrastructure corruption is repaired, not waived; override-rejection tested); (2) removal ordering completed — registry-delete failure after successful worktree removal exits non-zero naming the orphan (status model renders it broken) and a narrowly-scoped audited registry-only completion re-run closes it; (3) contract journey states renamed to match the decided semantics: divergent_reported (default, report-only) + overwrite_refused (copy-time), resolving the divergent_refused ambiguity.

Round-3 findings (100% clearance; 1 high scope_guard + 2 med) resolved: (1) EXPLICIT SCOPING DECISION — the wrong-worktree guard covers PLAN-GATE commands only (lock/audit/close/disposition/dispatch); worktree create/remove are worktree-MANAGEMENT commands deliberately outside it, protected by their own preconditions (strict load, binding_health, cleanliness, non-overridable corrupt-registry refusal) and tested to run unguarded from the main checkout; (2) audit-first semantics corrected to TWO entries — removal-INTENT flushed before destruction (never claims success) + removal-OUTCOME after; the registry-only completion path keys on intent + absent worktree, fixing the round-2 text that would have recorded success pre-destruction; (3) symlink rule made deterministic at both ends — symlinked allowlisted sources skipped+reported, symlinked targets treated as divergent and refused at copy time, never dereferenced.
rationale: One offline pass, one re-lock. Counts 3->3->3 with full clearance each round and shrinking severity profile.
